notes: Built from the build sheet docs/ship_pipeline/build_sheets/hegemony_HF1D/ (design file tools/blender/build_sheets/ships/hegemony_HF1D.py; issue 793). The sheet is the one home of the design (RULEBOOK 0.9, R225): masses, parts, mounts, the seam, the small inside and the length (LENGTH 1.6, CLS_LEN Squadron; drawn 3.84 on the board, scale.md) come from it through tools/blender/build_sheets/contract.py. game_ship fighter is the data.js wing (the Hegemony launches fighters, data.js FACTIONS hegemony sq 'fighter'); game_code is a placeholder: the game builds every craft in code today (godot/render/squadron_craft.gd, drawn by squadron_wing.gd) and no glb route for a sheet craft exists yet, so no stage 7 install until the Board opens that job. bake none: the Hegemony paint stack (tools/blender/kits/hegemony/stack.py, issue 780) is applied later.
